games.name: Panic at the Pole
games.description: Grab up to 5 friends and try to save Christmas! Team up to build and wrap toys, feed reindeers, chase away the gift gremilins and appease a high-maintenance Santa. Work together to earn enough coins to buy your way out of an endless contract before Christmas morning!

games.name: Secret Shelf: Collectible Shop Simulator
games.description: Run a blind box figure shop: stock the shelves, set your prices, serve the queue. Then open a box from your own stock and cross your fingers for the secret. 290 figures, 32 series, a game hall across the street and up to 4 players in co-op.

games.name: Fifth Tier
games.description: Fast, readable football management. You don't just pick the XI — you own the club. Take a small side from the fourth tier of a five-tier pyramid towards the top: tactics, wages, stands, academy, shares. Then sell up and buy a bigger club. A whole season can be played in an evening.

games.name: Paper Shredder
games.description: Shred your company's paperwork to earn a $1,000,000 payout. Paper Shredder is an incremental game where a sheet-after-sheet grind scales into mass document destruction. Shred, sweep, upgrade, and cut down tower-high piles of confidential records to uncover what’s buried beneath. Will you sign?

games.name: Moove
games.description: Saddle up with your friends and drive a herd of cows across a wild frontier. Cowboys, lassos, tornadoes, wolves and a lot of shouting. Lose as few cows as you can, or die trying and come back as one.

games.name: Lights Out
games.description: Escape through a procedurally generated dungeon full of different monsters and dangers. Work as a team to gather resources, craft tools and use your Light to fight against the hazards of this world, before you run out of coal and all will be covered in darkness.

games.name: Hello! Dango! Desktop!
games.description: "Hello! Dango! Desktop!" is an idle desktop pet game. Let your little buddies hang from your monitor, perch on windows, or swing from your mouse as you move the cursor. Add a little cuteness to your everyday work and study!

games.name: Nonogram Classics
games.description: Classical nonogram puzzles: 1000+ puzzles, 50+ distinct themes. Solve puzzles and unlock unique images. Newcomer in nonograms? Start with tutorial and small puzzles. Expert? Challenge large and complex nonograms. Complete 'em all!

games.name: Fox Arcana
games.description: FOX ARCANA is a pixel art roguelike survivor. You play a fox against hordes of monsters, backed by the creatures you free, in a world that shifts to a new season with every boss you defeat.

games.name: Loot List: Thief Sim
games.description: Rise from pauper to master thief - grab the loot list and get to work, whether it’s a roadside diner or a federal vault: slip past security and make fools of everyone, or unleash chaos and blow the place apart. Fence the haul to upgrade the hideout, gear up, and build your criminal empire.

games.name: Othria
games.description: Othria is a dark pixel-art action RPG with survivors-like autocast combat. Fight endless hordes, watch them burst into loot, craft gear with orbs and grow your passive tree. Beat each island's boss to open the next. One permanent hero, nothing resets: every level, item and point you earn stays.

games.name: Pinata
games.description: Hit a giant piñata with up to 7 friends in first-person co-op. Coins fall out, roll down a spiral funnel into your vault and buy you bigger weapons: a bow, a machine gun, a hwacha, archers. When it bursts, a bigger one comes down from the clouds.

games.name: Pirate Ship Tidy Up
games.description: A storm has filled your pirate ship with fish and ridiculous clutter. Pick up, sort and tidy 3,500 objects across three decks, earn upgrades and uncover the captain's secret. Your chatty parrot has opinions. None of them involve doing all the work.

games.name: Starcrumb
games.description: A star fell into the forest. Tap it, and tiny mushroom folk carry its crumbs to the Lantern. Kindle the star, magnitude by magnitude, until it is whole again. A cozy incremental game where you can see every part work, with a real ending.

games.name: Don't Splat
games.description: Four blobs. One wall. Someone’s in the wrong place. Stretch, squish and shape-shift with your friends to squeeze through the gaps in Don't Splat!, a co-op game for 1–4 players, online or on one screen. You had a plan. The wall had other ideas.

games.name: Gunshot Arcade
games.description: Gunshot Arcade combines the action of a classic arcade shoot 'em up with the meta-progression of a roguelike. Buy some weapons, upgrade your gear and survive as long as you can. Unlock much stronger guns from wave to wave and reach a new record, good luck.

games.name: KEGGER
games.description: Race to deliver kegs. Shove your friends into trouble. KEGGER is a competitive party game for 1–4 local players: dodge traffic, catch moving boats, and recover your keg before time runs out. Fight for the most deliveries across 16 boards. Play solo or bring the crew.

games.name: Sidepeak
games.description: A tiny climber lives on the edge of your screen. Every key you press, in any app, carries them from Montmartre to Everest, real peaks at their real altitude. Take a break and they pitch camp, which you decorate with their finds. And when the mountains run out? That's for you to find out.

games.name: EYESIGHT
games.description: Tag party game where seeing is a skill

games.name: One More Chest!
games.description: One More Chest! is an active incremental game about smashing chests that walk, bite and explode. Hover and your hammer swings for you: chain lightning across the desk, set off bombs, spread lava, unlock six hammers and prestige until one swing sets off the whole table.

games.name: Pay Up, Piggy
games.description: You're the kid who owes Finn the loan shark. Smash piggy banks, stack the coins and pay the Boss's weekly cut, or you're done. Upgrade your hammer, call in Favors, survive the Showdowns and climb Port Penny's mob.

games.name: fogpost
games.description: Guide a courier and a delayed echo through 250 turn-based puzzles. Collect the letter, plan around tides, bridges and shifting routes, and light both beacons on the same turn. Undo, use hints, then refine your route to earn gold stamps.

games.name: Cat-Eye: Nail Salon Simulator
games.description: Soak off old polish, file and shape real 3D nails, then pull a glowing cat-eye band to life with a magnet. A cozy nail salon sim with fair scoring, regulars with stories, disaster rescues and influencer ready one-click vertical clips to share every set.

games.name: Tidy Up the Cars Together
games.description: Sort through 2,100+ loose car parts and put a garage full of classics back together. Hammer bent frames into shape, wash dirty parts and listen for the engine when the last piece clicks in. Play solo or invite friends to join you online.

games.name: Lost City of Kane
games.description: Start with a stick in an empty field and dig up to 300 metres down to a buried city. Sell the dirt, hire a crew of goblins, put up cranes, rails and goblin-powered machines, and find your way home, alone or with up to seven friends.

games.name: Let the cat fish!
games.description: Let a little fishing cat live along the bottom of your desktop. Catch and collect rare fish, build a cozy tower floor by floor, equip cannons against cute seaside monsters, dress up the tower and taskbar, and shrink the game to a tiny companion while you work.

games.name: DUSKCRAWLER Minesweeper RPG
games.description: Your character walks across the tiles you open, and the monsters move with you — the "Minesweeper × Dungeon RPG" that feels long overdue! No luck, pure logic. Gold, chests and items lie hidden beneath the tiles. Defeat monsters, collect gold and power up to reach the bottom of all 150 stages!

games.name: Idle Caravan
games.description: A cozy idle adventure you can play in a small desktop window. Ride your giant bison across a magical world, deliver packages, discover creatures, and let your journey continue while you do other things.

games.name: Dynamine
games.description: Dynamine is an incremental mining game based on Minesweeper. Dig for ores while avoiding explosives, sell what you found, buy better tools to dig more efficiently, then rinse and repeat!

games.name: Grow Wild
games.description: Plant trees and wildflowers, create wildlife habitats, and discover hundreds of creatures in this cozy relaxing nature game. Transform empty landscapes into living ecosystems as you bring nature back to life.

games.name: Too Fun
games.description: Too Fun is a 2–8 player party game. Compete with your friends in episodes that test your skill, your bluffing and your communication. Outplay your rivals and become the star of the show.

games.name: Bank Life Simulator
games.description: Build, manage, and grow your own bank branch! Handle teller transactions, spot fake IDs, and offer loans and deposits to a living population. Hire and train staff, trade on the stock and black markets, survive strict audits, and rise from a small branch to a financial empire.

games.name: Homicidy
games.description: Somebody had a very bad night. Now it's your shift. Scrub fifty crime scenes spotless in this cozy-macabre pixel-art cleaning game: mop, foam, vacuum and luminol your way to three stars, then spend the pay on a nicer mop. You do the crime. We do the grime.

games.name: XX GAME: The Evolution Merge Puzzle
games.description: “XX GAME: The Evolution Merge Puzzle” is a physics-based merge puzzle game about evolution. Start as a tiny strawberry and evolve into insects, animals, humans, and beyond. Merge uniquely shaped characters and experience an evolutionary journey across 9 stages.

games.name: HELLFIGHTERS
games.description: A physics-driven co-op game for 4 players about goose firefighters tied together by one fire hose. On the way from a burning city down to Hell, stack into a wobbly tower, fly over pits on extinguisher recoil and haul your friends back up. But if one goose slips, everyone falls...

games.name: Just One More Load
games.description: Swing a magnet crane over a cartoon scrapyard, grab as much junk as your battery allows and drop it in the press for combo cash. Grow a 250-node skill tree, collect 17 magnet heads, clear five yards and tell yourself: just one more load.

games.name: Space Gas Station Simulator
games.description: Run a first-person orbital gas station solo or in online co-op for up to 4 players. Refuel ships, ring up travelers, and unload cargo shuttles. Reinvest your shared earnings to expand the station, then defend it when pirates land.

games.name: Diving Club
games.description: Diving Club is a pixel-art diving game. Dive from springboards, high platforms and 20 m cliffs. The judges score each dive on difficulty and execution. Win competitions, grow your club and work your way up to the World Games. Compete against other players in online tournaments.

games.name: Orb Immortal
games.description: Roll your god's crystal orb through 150+ hand-built stages across the heavens, into the cosmos, and beyond the halls of the divine. Tilt the world to chase medals and leaderboards and shatter the statues of your rivals. Race your friends and compete to be the first to reach the secret levels.

games.name: RE: Rags to Royalties
games.description: Build a web-novel empire in this incremental management game set in 2004. Tap, upgrade and unleash FEVER; win readers, sign contracts and run a busy studio. With AI-assisted creation, turn your own ideas into a novel you can actually read. Your cat is already on the keyboard.

games.name: Dig Up
games.description: You are Elliot: broke, jobless, out of options. You sign up for a contest with a huge prize and wake up 48 meters underground with a shovel in your hand. Dig, sell, buy ladders and crack the door code hidden in the notes of those who never made it out. The cameras are always watching.

games.name: 牛马的涌现
games.description: A lightweight idle management game that lives along the bottom of your desktop. Hire quirky workers, pair them up to discover new offspring, collect breeds, traits and coats, decorate the office, and expand your company while you work.

games.name: Twilight Park
games.description: Escape the amusement park before it's too late... You were invited to an amusement park, it was supposed to be fun. But soon, you realized you were trapped in the park. Can you escape the park? Investigate the environment, find useful items, solve puzzles, and escape the park before it's too late..

games.name: The Last Button
games.description: Buy block-shaped buttons, fit them onto a floating board and click them for cash. Harder shapes pay bigger multipliers. Coat buttons in 40 materials, let rabbits, drones and a repair robot work for you, ride out storms and meteor showers, and grow your board until the Last Button fits.

games.name: Herb Z
games.description: The world is ending. Business is booming! Run your own survival supply shop in a zombie-infested city. Grow herbs, craft essential supplies, stock your shelves, and serve desperate survivors in this retro-inspired survival horror shop simulator!

games.name: Desktop Gugu: Cozy Idle Pet
games.description: A cozy desktop idle game with two pet species: a mining duck and a leaf-topped mushroom. Sweep up crystals and timber, sell resources, feed your helpers, and combine duck talents. Adjust music and desktop settings to suit your day.

games.name: UnepicTale
games.description: The dragon stole the princess, and now your path leads through dark forests and eerie swamps, teeming with fairy-tale creatures. Flip the card and prove you can handle the choice in the card game UnepicTale!

games.name: Mahjong Kart
games.description: Mahjong meets kart racing! Drive tiles back to your base to collect them, use items to disrupt rivals, and be first to complete a winning hand. Play online with up to four players or face off in local split-screen.

games.name: Robot Crucible
games.description: Build a fighting robot in 5 minutes, or perfect it over 5 hours, then destroy your opponents! Sketch out a chassis, snap on some motors and wheels, choose a weapon, and throw it into the arena against the AI or friends in local multiplayer.

games.name: Penguin Trails Together
games.description: It all starts with a line. Draw a ramp and send Pengu soaring toward the stars on a sled. Or team up with up to three friends, build a track full of loops, and see who sticks the landing.

games.name: RUNEBLADE
games.description: A knight against the endless dark. Three oaths, three lands, ten minutes a run — and a King at the end of each. Your weapons strike on their own: all you choose is where to stand. Fall, and the Sanctum keeps what you carried out.

games.name: Orbit Foundry
games.description: Turn a handful of machines into a bustling factory around a growing star. Orbit Foundry is a space incremental idle game where you reinvest your output, research upgrades, and automate your fleet. Watch production climb as your star changes color.

games.name: Cardelis
games.description: A competitive pixel art card collecting game. Open boosters, build your deck and face real players in PvP. Climb the leaderboard and prove you're the best!

games.name: Battle Worms
games.description: Get your parts, build your creature, go! Compete with your friends in a series of minigames, adding new parts along the way, to see whose custom creature is the best… or maybe just the funniest. Featuring online PVP, procedural physics and open-ended creature building, how you play is up to you!

games.name: Delta 4 Terminal Protocol
games.description: Wake up to silence. One terminal, one survivor, one dying ship. Can you bring the Delta-4 back online? Delta 4 is a sci-fi survival terminal sim—type commands, decode logs, and fight to keep a dying ship alive.

games.name: Billard Masters Legacy
games.description: Precision cue sports powered by deterministic 1,000 Hz physics! Play 8-Ball, 9-Ball, Snooker, 3-Cushion & Carom in the Online Club or vs PC. Conquer 30 Master Challenges, build custom layouts, and collect 84 cues with live match chronicles across 15 atmospheric 3D venues.

games.name: Incremortal: Xianxia Ascension
games.description: An incremental game about Xianxia cultivation. Slay monsters, gather spiritual qi, refine elixirs, break through realms, and ascend to immortality.

games.name: BetterAtGambling
games.description: Think you're the best gambler in your friend group? Prove it. Hit the tables, survive the minigames, and if luck runs out, just take the chips from whoever's in the lead. In the end, only one of you is better at gambling.

games.name: Incremental POP: Fishing
games.description: A hoop net, fifteen seconds, a lot of fish. Every round you buy something sillier: harpoons, depth charges, a sea serpent, a whale. Keep going until the screen is mostly fish and the numbers stop making sense.

games.name: Flipside 86
games.description: A coin-flicking roguelike in a neon 1986 casino. Slingshot coins into the bowl, bounce them into a JACKPOT CHAIN, stack CHIPS × MULT, then spend the winnings at Lucky's bar. 100 tables, 10 venues, one House to break. Then let it ride.
